name: Goi ca nhech
summary: Gỏi cá nhệch is the Kim Sơn fish salad on the 15 February 2023 culture list. A 5 November 2024 tourism article also names gỏi nhệch for Kim Sơn.
origin: Kim Sơn, the same coast as Phát Diệm. The culture page is the list.
howToEat: The opened culture extract names the dish and does not print the herb wrap. Check on arrival.
where: Kim Sơn, the coast named with gỏi nhệch on the 5 November 2024 tourism article. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Goi ca nhech — Kim Son fish salad
seoDescription: Kim Sơn fish salad, gỏi cá nhệch, on the Ninh Bình culture list and the 2024 tourism article.
